item.title: 🗓 On August 27, Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov met with Anna Tsivileva, Chair of the State Foundation for Support of Participants of the Special Military Operation
item.description: 🗓 On August 27, Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov met with Anna Tsivileva, Chair of the State Foundation for Support of Participants of the Special Military Operation “Defenders of the Fatherland,” and combat veterans taking part in the annual forum Together We Will Win. During the informal conversation, Sergey Lavrov spoke in detail about the current challenges facing Russian diplomacy and the country’s foreign policy priorities. The Minister warmly thanked the veterans for their courage, valour, and sincere devotion to the Fatherland on the front lines. ❗️ The meeting participants expressed confidence that, despite the West’s ongoing hybrid war against Russia and its extensive support for Ukraine, all the goals of the special military operation will be achieved. Answering questions, Sergey Lavrov detailed the Ministry’s efforts to support participants in the special military operation. He outlined plans for further development of the professional retraining programme, which has been implemented since 2024 at the Main Directorate of the Ministry of Defence and MGIMO University, in collaboration with the Defenders of the Fatherland Foundation. The programme is aimed at the social integration and employment of trainees in the civilian sector. Following the fourth stage of the programme, completed in July 2026, it is planned to expand the number of participants and the scope of the courses, taking into account feedback from graduates.

item.title: ✉️ On August 27, President of Russia Vladimir Putin expressed condolences to President of China
item.description: ✉️ On August 27, President of Russia Vladimir Putin expressed condolences to President of China Xi Jinping . ✍️ I would like to express my deepest condolences over the tragic consequences of the mudslides in China’s Tibet Autonomous Region. Please convey my sympathy and support to those who lost their family members and loved ones in this natural disaster, as well as my wishes for a speedy recovery to all those injured. Respectfully, VLADIMIR PUTIN

item.title: ⚡️ Ambassador-at-Large of the Russian Ministry of Foreign Affairs Rodion Miroshnik On August 26, the Kievsky District of Donetsk
item.description: ⚡️ Ambassador-at-Large of the Russian Ministry of Foreign Affairs Rodion Miroshnik : On August 26, the Kievsky District of Donetsk was attacked with Storm Shadow/SCALP-EG missiles. Eight people were injured, including two children. According to the head of the Donetsk People’s Republic , the district was struck with British-French long-range air-launched Storm Shadow/SCALP-EG cruise missiles . The main strike hit the area around the Donetsk City shopping and entertainment center . A girl born in 2016 and a woman born in 1973 sustained moderate injuries. Also injured were a teenage girl born in 2010, a woman born in 1947, and four men born in 1987, 1981, 1977 and 1949. As soon as the British PM spoke of sharing the technology behind these missiles with Kiev , they were used against civilian targets. ❗️ Ukrainian terrorists behave like drug addicts – once they get their hands on something, they rush to use it, usually in the most dangerous way possible for those around them.

item.title: ☢️ Zaporozhskaya Nuclear Power Plant #ZNPP On August 26, the Zaporozhskaya NPP, operated by
item.description: ☢️ Zaporozhskaya Nuclear Power Plant ( #ZNPP ): On August 26, the Zaporozhskaya NPP, operated by Rosatom , came under a Ukrainian drone attack targeting its dry spent nuclear fuel storage facility. No significant damage was recorded and no personnel were injured . No environmental impact was detected, while radiation levels at the plant and in the surrounding area remain within normal limits. ❗️ An attack on a spent nuclear fuel storage facility is an extremely dangerous and unacceptable act . Damage to the infrastructure ensuring the safe storage of spent nuclear fuel could have serious consequences and poses a potential threat to nuclear and radiation safety. ZNPP personnel are taking all necessary measures to ensure the plant’s safe operation.

item.title: ⚡️ On August 27, Chargé d’Affaires a.i. of Romania in Russia Liliana Burda was summoned
item.description: ⚡️ On August 27, Chargé d’Affaires a.i. of Romania in Russia Liliana Burda was summoned to the Russian Foreign Ministry’s Department of State Protocol . She was issued a Russian MFA note declaring an employee of the Romanian Embassy in Moscow persona non grata . This measure comes in response to the Romanian side’s earlier unsubstantiated decision to declare an employee of the Russian Embassy in Bucharest persona non grata.

item.title: 💬 #KievRegimeCrimes Ambassador-at-Large of the Russian Ministry of Foreign Affairs Rodion Miroshnik
item.description: #KievRegimeCrimes 💬 Ambassador-at-Large of the Russian Ministry of Foreign Affairs Rodion Miroshnik : On August 26, nine people were killed in a Ukrainian strike on a civilian bus in the Lugansk People's Republic. Five people were injured . The bus was travelling on the Lisichansk-Stakhanov route. *** 💬 Head of the Lugansk People's Republic Leonid Pasechnik : Eight people were killed at the scene. A 20-year-old woman was rushed to intensive care, but doctors were unable to save her. Her mother was injured. An 18-year-old woman was also wounded and hospitalized. Three other passengers and the driver received medical treatment and were released for outpatient care. ❗️ This is yet another act of terrorism by the Kiev regime – cynical, inhuman and without justification. It is a war crime , and those responsible will inevitably face the punishment they deserve. Investigators from the Russian Investigative Committee are documenting the consequences of the attack .

item.title: 🇷🇺 On August 26, Foreign Minister of Russia Sergey Lavrov and Minister of Foreign Affairs, Emigration and Egyptian Expatriates Badr Abdelatty
item.description: 🇷🇺 🇪🇬 📞 On August 26, Foreign Minister of Russia Sergey Lavrov and Minister of Foreign Affairs, Emigration and Egyptian Expatriates Badr Abdelatty had a telephone conversation at the initiative of the Egyptian Side. The Foreign Ministers discussed the current situation in the Middle East , including the unprecedented escalation of the military and political situation in the Persian Gulf as a result of US-Israeli aggression against Iran . They stressed the need to step up collective political and diplomatic efforts aimed at de-escalating tensions and laying a reliable foundation for regional security . The Ministers reaffirmed their shared position on the need to resolve the Palestinian issue in accordance with UN resolutions . Sergey Lavrov briefed his Egyptian counterpart on the latest developments surrounding the Ukraine crisis , including the sharply deteriorating situation in the Black Sea region as a result of the Kiev regime's criminal actions to destroy civilian vessels and energy infrastructure. The Ministers held a substantive discussion on current bilateral cooperation , stressing the importance of maintaining close coordination to further strengthen trade and economic ties between Russia and Egypt. 🤝 They also exchanged views on ways to further develop Russia's partnership with the African Union and the League of Arab States . #RussiaEgypt
